trace.evidence: When current_user_can('unfiltered_html') is false, map_deep applies wp_kses_post to every non-boolean, non-null leaf in the entire supplied data array.
The API accepts and returns strings; numeric scalars passed by Elementor's map_deep are processed through the string KSES pipeline.
The already-KSES-processed elements are passed to get_elements_raw_data, encoded with wp_json_encode/wp_slash, and written with update_metadata.
During saving, each element instance returns get_data_for_save(). No code converts numeric strings back to numbers.
Returns raw element data and on_save settings; it retains the KSES-produced scalar types.
Both numeric strings and numbers pass is_numeric and are returned for CSS/control use.
Elementor's editor save convention sends the complete elements document plus document settings to Document::save; no supported widget-only persistence operation is exposed here.

proven_conversion_mechanism: The Writer intentionally lacks unfiltered_html, so Elementor's whole-document KSES branch stringifies numeric leaves before persistence.
repeat_save_prediction: The same 140 values will remain or become strings on every save through the same no-unfiltered_html path.
